The name Rebab is a reminder of this rich musical heritage and the cultural significance of music in Islamic and Arabic societies.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Rebab is a symbol of the human soul, which is compared to a reed that bends and sways in the wind. Just as the reed bends and sways, yet remains strong, the human soul is subject to trials and tribulations, yet remains resilient and unbroken. The name Rebab also evokes images of the reed in the story of Imam Husain (as) in Karbala, who is described as having his head held in a reed, a sign of ultimate humility and submission to God.
